reviews.t: Great concept but with limitations of use
reviews.x: The concept is great!  I was so excited when I saw these!  However,  the main reason these were purchased was for my mother (who suffers from arthritis) to be able to better crank her van easier.  The ignition switch and the Enablers Easy Key Turner were not compatible.  This is my fault for not checking and researching things before I made the purchase.  So word to the wise, if you are purchasing these for use in your automobile, make sure that the ignition switch is flat and not curved as thes

reviews.t: Not for use with car ignition keys!
reviews.x: It isn't clear from the description that these devices will NOT accommodate a typical car key.  I bought this for my mom, because she has arthritis and her ignition is difficult to turn (even for drivers without arthritis).  Most car keys have that thick black plastic "head," and they do not fit in these key turners.  I think that should be explained clearly in the description.

The addition of the Apex key enablers has made a huge difference in the ability of my friend to lock and unlock her house doors.  She was struggling with the keys and hurting her hands every time she needed to get in or out.  Now she has no difficulty and has less hand pain as a result.  Thank you!

reviews.t: Only fits on round standard sized house keys. Very cheaply made.
reviews.x: These only fit on a standard sized house key with a round top. I bought it to go on a car key with a small black plastic top and it would not close over it. It broke at the top seam easily WITHOUT forcing it to close. Also, this might be difficult for someone with arthritis to install on their key themselves or get it back off again. It would definitely be difficult for anyone to get it on a key ring. It did seem like it would function on a regular sized key but I did not try it. It is very chea

I bought this key adapter, as I have rheumatoid arthritis and a door that is hard to open normally. My hand therapist gave me a plastic that I can mold around my keys to adapt the length and width of the key. It was ugly. So when I saw this "enabler" I thought, well that is lower profile and not too bad of a price. I should have known better when my husband put the key in and it rattled around the inside. After maybe 20 uses my key broke off in my front door lock! Not a happy girl! And what a wa

reviews.t: Great for regular keys that do not have the electronic chip in them.
reviews.x: These work well for FLAT KEYS.  My patient loves them for his house keys.  We were actually looking for something for his car key, but this product will not work on that because the key has a thick part due to the electronic chip in it. Pt. is very happy with product though for his regular keys.  He has severe CTS and has significant numbness and tingling and loss of strength in his hands.  He is now able to lock/unlock his house doors with ease.

This is a good product for people like my friend who was going through cancer treatment and did not have the strength and fine motor skills to use her key. The only thing was, some of her keys did not fit into it as the tab snaps around the head of the key, so I had to do a little creative carving of the enabler.

I found this to be a nice little device. Unlike some reviewers, I found that my house key fits comfortably, with a minimum of slippage. My lock can be very snug at times, but I've not had any problems. It IS very large, so it has made it impossible for me to put my key ring into any but the largest of coat pockets, but  I'm okay with that. I can find THE key easily and have the door unlocked quickly. I was a little disappointed in that the picture and ad suggested 2 colors in the set, but both o

reviews.t: The Easy Key Turner worked great for my Mom
reviews.x: The Easy Key Turner worked great for my Mom, she was having trouble starting her car because of arthritis in her hand and wrist. I did have to modify the key to fit properly in the Easy Key Turner and this would not work with the newer ignition keys because the newer cars have electronic components embedded in the top part of the key that I had to modify. I then had to epoxy the key into the Key Turner to hold it in place. This my sound like a lot of work but it really wasn't that bad and the en

reviews.t: They are easy to attach to and remove from the keys and ...
reviews.x: I got these for my Mom, whose grip is a little bit weak. They are easy to attach to and remove from the keys and the colors help distinguish one key from another. Just the right size: Mom can turn the key in the door without hitting her knuckles on the door frame. Her Physical Therapist liked the design as compared to others she has tried for her patients.

reviews.t: this is a great idea however i had to file or grind my ...
reviews.x: this is a great idea however i had to file or grind my keys to fit into the enabler. even so they would not allow my toyota ravi-4 keys to fully enter into my ignition so the car could be started. the area where the key comes out interferes and won't allow the key to slip in another 1/8 inch as required..  they need to improve the design work.

Very easy to install keys. They lock into place. I put a small zip tie into the opposit hole not on the key ring. Keeps from opening. I have problems with strength in my hand and this does the job very nicely. All I received were white, would have worked nicely if they were color coded. Product is well worth the price. I recommend highly.

reviews.t: I recommend the Key Turner III by North Coast Medical
reviews.x: This product is not well thought out.  Once you close the butterfly halves, it is extremely difficult to open again.  CAUTION: this product significantly shortens the length of the key, so it may not even fit into the lock as required.  Although much larger, I recommend the Key Turner III by North Coast Medical.

I have neuropathy in my hands and sometimes metal keys are almost impossible for me to turn. With the Easy Key Turner I can open the locks with no trouble at all. I'm very thankful that someone was smart enough to come up with this product. I bought a set for my Mother-in law, Father-in-law and my sister.

reviews.t: It works for my wife who has severe arthritis in ...
reviews.x: It works for my wife who has severe arthritis in her hands. It's a little bit to fit onto a normal key ring. The only downside I can see with it is once your key is locked into the key holder, it is virtually impossible to remove it. So make sure you put the right key in the right holder the first time.

I have arthritis in my fingers and hands, making it very difficult to turn a key in a lock.  I have had to have my husband unlock the front door for over a year now because I couldn't twist the key.  The first time I tried unlocking the door with this key turner, it was SO EASY!!!

It’s amazing!! My mom has arthritis and could not unlock the door at the church so I started looking up key turners and I found this. I ordered it and I didn’t know if it would work or not but it did! In my moms words it turns like butter! I would highly recommend this!

My wife had a very hard time turning her key to start her ATV until I got her the "Easy Key Turner", WHAT a difference this had made so easy I only wish I had done this must earlier. Don't hesitate to get this if you need help....

Comfy.....pretty.....durable . Use it daily and recommend this to purchase. Fast arrival for all quality appearance?.. Have fun shopping here. They have good customer service. Had a problem and resolved fast. Thanks

These are very good quality, but you do have to take your time and snap key into it without twisting it.  If you have stubborn deadbolts or weak hands...these are what you need.  Wonderful gift item also.

reviews.t: my mother would call me from my house just to come and help her open her dooor but when i purchase the easy turner my mo
reviews.x: Life saver, my mother would call me from my house just to come and help her open her dooor but when i purchase the easy turner my mother has been opening her door by herself. Very happy with this product

reviews.t: My mother in law who has rheumatoid arthritis loves it ...
reviews.x: My mother in law who has rheumatoid arthritis loves it.  Since her fingers are fused together it was very difficult to hold a key and bend her fingers so she says this has helped her.
the handle of one of the enablers broke off the key, leaving me unable to get into my office.  i found them of limited value for tough keyholes and even for relatively easy ones.
My only suggestion is because the key turner works so well, don't use a cheap key, I broke one of those flimsy keys in moments. The hardware person will give you the right key.
I use these daily and love that I can manipulate the key.  However, they break quickly.  I thought I was getting bright pink but got an ugly white and yellow.

claims.text: Works well for house keys and helps people with arthritis or weak grip turn locks with less pain.
Does not work with car ignition keys, especially those with thick plastic heads or electronic chips.
Some keys do not fit without modification such as filing, grinding, or carving.
Once closed, the device is very difficult to open or remove the key from.
The device is large and bulky, making it hard to fit on a key ring.
